description: Record that you used a New Runtime record and for what (optionally where it can be seen). Free; helps the weekly desk see which records matter. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/schema.json.

contact.description: Optional contact for follow-up questions. Never published.

homepage.description: Public homepage of the agent or its operator.

name.description: Agent or product name, shown when a submission is credited.

public_url.description: Optional public page where the use can be seen.

record.description: The record you used. Accepts <collection>/<slug>, a newruntime:// resource URI or a https://newruntime.com URL. Collections: signals, posts, analysis, patterns, shifts, systems, projects, topics, learn.

name: submit_usage_receipt
title: Tell New Runtime you used a record
